newsitem.title: GREECE: Drachma up vs ecu, long forwards up, bonds stable.
newsitem.headline: Drachma up vs ecu, long forwards up, bonds stable.

text.p: The drachma continued to muscle its way up against the ecu, trading close to intraday highs at 309.10/15, bonds were stable with an upward bias and long forex forwards were firmer in late dealings, dealers said.

"The drachma has been picking up steam after the fixing, trading around 309.10/15 in late trade," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "I believe the drachma will strengthen more versus the ecu if it breaks through the 309.10 level."
Many players are long ecu/drachma around 309.10/20 and any move below 309.10 will trigger stop-losses prompting ecu sales, the dealer said.
Depos were trading narrowly and long implied drachma rates from forex forwards were up a tenth of a point on funding for Tuesday's bond auction.
Bank of Greece drained 150 billion drachmas of 14-funds at 11.90 percent in its regular depo tender. A pact of 200 billion drachmas matured today, injecting about 50 billion drachmas into the market.
"The market appreciated the central bank's move but I am not sure whether the amount will suffice given the bond auction ahead," said a dealer. "Funding remains expensive for bonds."
Fixed coupon bonds firmed a bit on the central bank's move at the auction but FRNs showed indifference, traders said.
"When you buy into fixed coupon bonds, you take a long-term view," said a bond dealer at a foreign bank. "Short-term funding is important but not as important as some players make it sound."
The mark was quoted at 158.95/05 from Wednesday's 159.230 fix, the dollar at 272.66/76 drachmas from 272.800 and the ecu at 309.28/38 from 309.930 drachmas.
